BIOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Animals.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement in Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement in Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement in Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement in Animals.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Plants.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Plants.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Plants.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support in Plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support in Plants.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support in Plants.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Support in Plants.

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.

19. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Genetics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Genetics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Genetics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Genetics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. In three clear sentences, explain Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Support in Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination in Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Genetics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
